title: Juicy Nutty Cashew Stir-fry
description: A cozy British dish featuring nutty and juicy cashews with a touch of low-carb-friendly double cream for a perfect side or light meal.
instructions: Soak cashew nuts in water for at least an hour. Drain and pat dry.
In a pan, lightly toast the garlic slices until fragrant, being careful not to burn them.
Add cashews to the pan with the toasted garlic, tomato paste, and double cream. Mix well to combine all ingredients evenly.
Season with salt and pepper according to taste.
Transfer the mixture to an oven-proof dish and bake for 10-12 minutes or until golden brown on top and slightly crispy around the edges.
Stir in chopped parsley just before serving for a pop of color and flavor.
